displayName: SailPoint ISC — Failed or stalled remediation workflow
description: Detects a failed or stalled SailPoint remediation workflow or account activity and reports the operation, target account(s), failed connector source(s), authoritative HR source, connector error, and tracking id.
query:
let FailedWorkflows =
    SailPointISC_WorkflowHistory
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where IsFailure or (IsRemediation and Outcome !in ("SUCCESS", "COMPLETED", "COMPLETE", "PASSED"))
    | extend
        StepName = coalesce(tostring(Attributes.displayName), tostring(Attributes.stepName), ""),
        StepError = tostring(Attributes.error)
    | summarize
        TimeGenerated = max(TimeGenerated),
        Outcome = any(Outcome),
        Stage = anyif(HistType, HistType startswith "WORKFLOWEXECUTION" and HistType != "WORKFLOWEXECUTIONSTARTED"),
        FailedSteps = strcat_array(make_set_if(StepName, isnotempty(StepName) and isnotempty(StepError), 5), ", "),
        AllSteps = strcat_array(make_set_if(StepName, isnotempty(StepName), 5), ", "),
        ErrorMsg = anyif(StepError, isnotempty(StepError))
        by WorkflowExecutionId, FlowName, Owner, OwnerId, RequestId
    | extend
        Stage = coalesce(Stage, Outcome),
        StepSummary = coalesce(FailedSteps, AllSteps, Stage)
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Signal = "Workflow",
        Subject = coalesce(Owner, FlowName, "unknown"),
        IdentityId = coalesce(OwnerId, ""),
        Operation = FlowName,
        Outcome,
        Stage,
        Requester = Owner,
        FailedSources = "SailPoint ISC Workflows",
        TargetAccounts = coalesce(Owner, FlowName),
        TrackingId = coalesce(RequestId, WorkflowExecutionId),
        FailureDetail = substring(strcat("Workflow '", FlowName, "' ", Outcome, iff(isnotempty(StepSummary), strcat(" at step '", StepSummary, "'"), ""), iff(isnotempty(ErrorMsg), strcat(": ", ErrorMsg), "")), 0, 500);
let ActivityBase =
    SailPointISC_AccountActivities
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h)
    | where IsFailure or (StageName in ("PENDING", "QUEUED", "WAITING") and TimeGenerated < ago(1h));
let ActivityErrors =
    ActivityBase
    | mv-expand req = AccountRequests
    | where toupper(tostring(req.result.status)) in ("FAILED", "FAILURE", "ERROR", "FAIL")
        or isnotempty(tostring(req.result.errors[0]))
    | extend
        ReqSource = coalesce(tostring(req.source.name), tostring(req.provisioningTarget.name), "Unknown Source"),
        ReqAccount = coalesce(tostring(req.accountId), "default-account"),
        ReqOp = coalesce(tostring(req.op), "Operation")
    | extend
        AcctOnSource = strcat(ReqAccount, " [", ReqSource, "]"),
        line = strcat(
            ReqOp,
            " [acct: ", ReqAccount, "] on ",
            ReqSource,
            ": ",
            coalesce(tostring(req.result.errors[0]), toupper(tostring(req.result.status))))
    | summarize
        FailureDetail = strcat_array(make_list(line, 5), " | "),
        FailedSources = strcat_array(make_set(ReqSource, 5), ", "),
        TargetAccounts = strcat_array(make_set(AcctOnSource, 5), ", ")
        by Id;
let FailedActivities =
    ActivityBase
    | join kind=leftouter ActivityErrors on Id
    | project
        TimeGenerated,
        Signal = "AccountActivity",
        Subject = coalesce(Recipient, Requester, "unknown"),
        IdentityId = RecipientIdentityId,
        Operation,
        Outcome,
        Stage = StageName,
        Requester,
        FailedSources = coalesce(FailedSources, Sources, "SailPoint ISC"),
        TargetAccounts = coalesce(TargetAccounts, Recipient, "unknown"),
        TrackingId = TrackingNumber,
        FailureDetail = substring(coalesce(FailureDetail, strcat(Operation, " ", Outcome, " on ", coalesce(Sources, "SailPoint ISC"), ", stage ", StageName)), 0, 500);
union isfuzzy=true FailedWorkflows, FailedActivities
| extend
    SubjectBracketSource = extract(@"\[([^\]]+)\]\s*$", 1, Subject),
    CleanSubject = trim(" ", replace_regex(Subject, @"\s*\[[^\]]+\]\s*$", ""))
| extend SubjectKey = tolower(CleanSubject)
| join kind=leftouter (SailPointISC_Identities | project IdentityId, IdUpn = UserPrincipalName, IdDisplay = DisplayName, IdSource = IdentitySource, IdAuthSource = AuthoritativeSource) on IdentityId
| join kind=leftouter (SailPointISC_IdentityKeys | project SubjectKey = JoinKey, NameUpn = UserPrincipalName, NameDisplay = DisplayName, NameSource = IdentitySource, NameAuthSource = AuthoritativeSource) on SubjectKey
| extend
    UserPrincipalName = coalesce(IdUpn, NameUpn),
    DisplayName = coalesce(IdDisplay, NameDisplay, CleanSubject),
    IdentityAuthoritativeSource = coalesce(SubjectBracketSource, IdSource, NameSource, IdAuthSource, NameAuthSource, "SailPoint ISC")
| extend
    TargetIdentity = coalesce(DisplayName, CleanSubject),
    OperationAndOutcome = strcat(Operation, " ", Outcome),
    AlertTarget = strcat(coalesce(DisplayName, CleanSubject), iff(isnotempty(IdentityAuthoritativeSource) and IdentityAuthoritativeSource != "SailPoint ISC", strcat(" (HR: ", IdentityAuthoritativeSource, ")"), "")),
    ResponseAction = "Open this UPN in Assets > Identities, on the Entra list. Disable the Entra user, then revoke sessions.",
    UpnSuffix = tostring(split(UserPrincipalName, "@")[1]),
    AccountCustomEntity = iff(isnotempty(UserPrincipalName), UserPrincipalName, Subject)
| where isnotempty(Subject)
